This release supports **macOS 12 or later** on Apple Silicon and Intel.

A **Windows version is planned for a later release**. No Windows build is included.

For installation and personal API-key setup, see the [README](https://github.com/Skyline-23/homebrew-departure-board#install).

The code and project branding use the MIT license. Airline artwork retains its
third-party status; see [Third-party notices](https://github.com/Skyline-23/homebrew-departure-board/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
